title: tdh.util.ad.ui~
description: `tdh.util.ad.ui~` is a GUI-controlled three-stage envelope that ramps from 0 to a sustain level over the attack time, holds until its gate becomes 0, and then ramps back to 0 over the decay time; it provides both signal-rate and data-rate outputs. Sending a bang to the gate runs a fixed-duration envelope, while a positive gate value starts a variable-duration envelope.
